final: WITH g AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.type), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.type, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio - o.overall AS diff FROM g JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL
